name: BMD-1 / BMD-2
protection: Very thin aluminium armour (airborne vehicle). Game: immune to 5.56/5.45/7.62x39/7.62x51; 7.62x54R and larger can penetrate side/rear and disable wheels, engine and optics; every launcher in the game list penetrates. 12.7 mm penetrates from most angles.
visual_notes: Tiny low tracked hull with a sharp ribbed nose, five road wheels per side
BMP-1-style small cone turret (BMD-1) or 30 mm turret (BMD-2) sitting forward on the roof
Crew hatches clustered at the front, troop hatch at the rear top (no rear doors)
